pages.text: Every Sanctum has $(item)vaults$() behind a locked door. The key depends on the raid's difficulty:$(li)$(#8b2500)rusted$() in Normal$(li)$(#555555)silver$() in Nightmare$(li)$(#b8860b)gilded$() in Chaos$(br2)Right-click the door with the right key: better chests wait behind it.
Found in chests, or bought at the $(l:progress/altar)Altar$().
